# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V2004 unknown_field"
description: "The record type has no field with this name, or a record literal is missing required fields or names an extra one."
---

An error from the `type` phase. `sakura explain V2004` prints this explanation offline.

The record type has no field with this name, or a record literal is missing required fields or
names an extra one. Check the type's declaration for the field names; a record literal must list
every field (or start from another value with `{ ..r, field: v }`).

Wrong:

```sakura
type Point = { x: Int, y: Int }
fn depth(p: Point) -> Int { p.z }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
fn depth(p: Point) -> Int { p.y }
```
